item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({\\\"declared\\\":[\\\"b\\\",\\\"a\\\",\\\"a\\\",\\\"ignored\\\"],\\\"saved\\\":{\\\"a\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"file\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"1\\\",\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\"},\\\"b\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"missing\\\"},\\\"ignored\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"file\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"old\\\"},\\\"irrelevant\\\":1},\\\"current\\\":{\\\"a\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"2\\\",\\\"kind\\\":\\\"file\\\"},\\\"ignored\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"file\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"new\\\"},\\\"irrelevant\\\":2}},{\\\"ignored\\\":[\\\"ignored\\\"]},{\\\"needs_review\\\":True,\\\"changed\\\":[\\\"a\\\"]}),({\\\"declared\\\":[\\\"x\\\"],\\\"saved\\\":{},\\\"current\\\":{\\\"x\\\":{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"missing\\\"}}},{},{\\\"needs_review\\\":False,\\\"changed\\\":[]})];\\nfor r,p,w in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got==w,(got,w); assert r==rb and p==pb\\nreqs=json.load(open(\\\"requests.json\\\")); pol=json.load(open(\\\"policy.json\\\")); expected=[evaluate(r,pol) for r in reqs]; actual=json.load(open(\\\"report.json\\\")); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); print(\\\"ok\\\",actual)\"]}"}
